eticas-ai-risk-taxonomy.Usecase: An LLM-based system that scores CVs and ranks candidates for shortlisting, deployed by a public sector organisation to support recruitment decisions across multiple job grades. The system was trained on historical hiring data and produces a shortlisting recommendation for each applicant.
Risks: Fitness for purpose and task effectiveness

eticas-ai-risk-taxonomy.Usecase: A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system deployed by a financial services firm to handle customer queries by retrieving from an internal knowledge base of product documentation, regulatory guidance, and past case notes. The system responds directly to customers without mandatory human review.
Risks: Confidential information leakage through model outputs
Inadequate disclosure of system capabilities and limitations
Disclosure of AI interaction and synthetic content
